description: Grounded in the user's own hand-built sample.json workflow: shared CFG/Steps primitives feeding the sampler were 5/40, CLIPSetLastLayer was fixed at -2, and the quality/negative tag fragments below are the ones actually wired into the positive/negative CLIPTextEncode nodes. The three character/style LoRAs from that workflow were all disabled there, so they're listed here but off by default until per-request LoRA toggling exists.
positive_prompt_prefix: masterpiece,best quality,amazing quality,very aesthetic,newest,(5 fingers:1.05), furry, anthro, fingers, detailed background
negative_prompt_prefix: embedding:negativeXL_D, embedding:PonyXL_NegScore, low-res, worst quality, low quality, normal quality, jpeg artifacts, poorly drawn, ugly, disgusting, blurry, score_4, derpibooru_p_low, lowres, muscular, (hands:1), bulge, peace, simple background
